terms.definition: A verified person authorised to perform bounded professional work.
A bounded ability a Professional may be eligible to exercise.
Verifiable evidence supporting a Professional identity or capability.
A certification issued under an identified scheme and validity period.
A named and bounded professional or analytical approach.
A defined scope of work offered for a stated purpose and outcome.
A separately identifiable item that may be offered or delivered.
A versioned commercial presentation of a Product or Service.
A versioned monetary term attached to an Offer.
A customer request to acquire a specific Offer under fixed terms.
A recorded transfer attempt or confirmed transfer against an Order.
A bounded right granted after its own activation conditions are satisfied.
An explicit, scoped, purposeful and revocable permission from the data subject.
A bounded relationship assigning a Professional to a client, Service, purpose and permitted resources.
An authorised projection through which bounded work is viewed or performed.
Source-labelled material admitted under the canonical Evidence boundary.
A persisted or append-only account of an authorised fact or operation.
Non-authoritative material awaiting validation or promotion by an authorised operation.
A versioned report derived from an existing Journey without replacing that Journey.
A source-labelled response authored by an identified Professional.
A versioned report produced within a declared specialist scope and method.
A versioned output composed for release under a Service and Assignment.
An explicit attributable act approving or releasing a Deliverable.
An authorised subsequent operation linked to prior work and lineage.
A recorded expression of dissatisfaction requiring governed handling.
A recorded event that may affect safety, security, privacy or service integrity.
A versioned rule issued by an identified governing authority.
An identified legal or operating entity with governed roles.
An explicit constraint that narrows an otherwise available action or scope.
The authority, policies, controls and accountability governing system operation.
A source-labelled knowledge item available under declared access conditions.
A governed routing decision for where and how a question may be handled.
A source-labelled statement of what was observed without automatic promotion to Evidence.
A deterministic assessment of whether required professional preconditions are satisfied.
A metered record of Provider invocation and outcome without promoting Provider output.

legacyAliases.reason: The legacy word conflates subject material, responsibility and projection.
A queue item may project assigned work or a subsequent operation.
The legacy word conflates human work allocation and provider execution.
Legacy project containers are read as Workspace projections; they do not create a new object type.
The handling purpose determines the canonical object.
The compound legacy name resolves to Product with an explicit Service reference.
The right is an Entitlement scoped by a Service reference.
Candidate content is non-authoritative until an explicit authorised promotion operation.
The acronym is retained for reads only; new writes use Journey Report.
Public Journey is a presentation of the existing Runtime Journey, never a second Journey or a PWS glossary object.
Reality Demo is a public experience label and does not create a formal object or Journey.
